title: Fate/EXTRA Record Game Streams Character Video for Saber
content: Aniplex started streaming the first character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Wednesday. The video features the character Saber, as voiced by Sakura Tange .
author: ANN

title: From The Apothecary Diaries to Jurassic Shadows: Norihiro Naganuma's Next Creative Challenge
content: What happens when the director behind Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ( The Apothecary Diaries ) and Mahoutsukai no Yome ( The Ancient Magus' Bride ) trades court intrigue and fantasy for dinosaurs, ninjas, and superpowered makeup?
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shiden Kanzaki Launches Black Bullet Reboot Project, New Original Work
content: Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint announced on Wednesday that Shiden Kanzaki 's Black Bullet light novel series will have a reboot with new content, as well as a completely new story.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Anime World Tour Part 2 Heads to Africa and Australia With Episode 1 Preview
content: KAGURABACHI anime has revealed details for Part 2 of its ongoing Anime World Tour, with the first 20 minutes of Episode 1 set to screen at upcoming conventions in Johannesburg and Melbourne. The next stops will take place at Comic Con Africa in Johannesburg and PAX Aus in Melbourne.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Black Bullet' Light Novel Relaunches After 12 Years
content: Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Shiden Kanzaki 's action sci-fi light novel Black Bullet is relaunching following a 12-year hiatus. The reboot, titled Black Bullet: New World Order , will be a revised and expanded version of the original light novel.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Kin to Tetsu' Concludes Serialization
content: Ayaka Katayama 's Kin to Tetsu ( Fungus and Iron ) has concluded with its 105th chapter in the October 2026 issue of Bessatsu Shounen Magazine on Tuesday, marking the end of the series' five-year serialization. Katayama began drawing the dystopian sci-fi suspense manga in Bessatsu Shounen Magazine in March 2021.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Reveals Main Trailer, New Visual, Cast, October 6 Premiere
content: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life anime revealed the main trailer and new visual, along with more cast and an October 6, 2026 premiere. The anime previously revealed an action trailer last month.

title: Netflix Reveals Its First Look At Fall 2026 Anime Schedule
content: Summer 2026 has been an exciting season for anime fans with the return of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War and Saga of Tanya the Evil . Along with the major sequels, the latest season also introduced fans to some major hits such as Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia and Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You.
